title: ISO Metadata
description: Contract for a qualified ISO consumed by Packer vSphere builds. The datastore is the authoritative library (see ADR 0004), so the required fields describe the datastore item. sha256 is the single qualified hash: the intake copy and the published datastore copy must both match it. Note that scripts/runner/validate-iso-metadata.sh reads only the `required` list from this file; the types and patterns below are documentation until something validates against them properly.

filename.description: The exact filename of the ISO, identical in both locations

datastore.description: Name of the vSphere datastore holding the published ISO, without brackets (for example datastore-01)

datastorePath.description: Path to the ISO within that datastore, without the [datastore] prefix (for example image-factory/iso/windows.iso). Packer's bracket form is composed from datastore + datastorePath rather than stored, so nothing has to parse or escape brackets.

sha256.description: The qualified SHA-256. Both the intake copy and the published datastore copy are verified against this one value

sizeBytes.description: The exact size of the ISO in bytes

originPath.description: The intake copy: where the ISO sat, under the same filename, before it was published to the datastore, typically the intake share. Stage 1 (scripts/runner/verify-iso.sh) reads this to locate that copy unless --source-path overrides it, and requires its file name to equal filename. It is not what the build boots. For an ISO that arrived inside a vendor archive under another name, use origin instead

origin.description: Provenance for an ISO delivered inside a vendor archive, where the ISO has a different name (so originPath and stage 1 cannot describe it). Records the archive and the member path; the member's SHA-256 equals sha256, verified on verifiedOn. Nothing reads this to locate a file

vendor.description: Where the archive was obtained, for example a vendor support portal

archive.description: Path of the archive as kept on the intake share

archiveSha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive itself, to compare with a checksum the vendor publishes

member.description: Path of the ISO inside the archive

verifiedOn.description: Date the member's SHA-256 was checked against sha256

qualifiedOn.description: Date the datastore copy first passed stage 2 against sha256, the qualification date (YYYY-MM-DD)
